name: New Hampshire
description: Follow New Hampshire, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze New Hampshire primary election results
changes.summary: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in New Hampshire, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

changes.title: New Hampshire primaries test Trump and the left
changes.summary: President Donald Trump’s endorsement will be put to the test once again Tuesday in New Hampshire’s primaries, where liberal Democrats are also looking to cap an ascendant primary season with additional victories.

changes.title: New Hampshire voters pick midterm nominees as Sen. Shaheen's exit sparks scramble for key seats
changes.summary: New Hampshire primary voters are choosing candidates for Congress, governor and the 424-seat state Legislature on Tuesday, and incumbents aren't the only familiar names on the ballot.

changes.title: New Hampshire's GOP primary features two familiar names from the past, and voters are fine with that
changes.summary: While voters elsewhere have embraced a decidedly anti-establishment sentiment this campaign season, New Hampshire Republican voters appear content with their choices and are poised to pick a familiar name over a fresh face on Tuesday.

changes.title: In the Midterms, Will the Nepo-Baby Attack Work?
changes.summary: A New Hampshire senator’s daughter is running for office, and finds her name being used against her.
